system.description:
You tweak your Shinobi Instrument, to allow you to release blasts of sound and wind, gaining the Sonic Cannon and Sonic Cannon Burst attacks.

When you take the Attack action, you can replace any number of attack you make with a Sonic Cannon attack. If you do not have the Extra Attack feature, beginning at 7th level, you can make two Sonic Cannon attacks instead of one.

Sonic Cannon. Make a ranged Ninjutsu (or Genjutsu) attack using your highest jutsu attack bonus against a creature you can see within 60 feet. On a hit, you deal 1d12 force damage. If you roll a 10 or higher on the damage die, the target gains 1 rank of Disorientation. This attack counts as using your Shinobi Instrument for features that call for it.

Sonic Cannon Burst. As an Action, you spend all remaining Resonance, releasing it as an overwhelming shockwave, forcing all creatures in a 30-foot cone originating from you to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure they take 1d12 force damage for every Resonance spent, or half as much damage on a successful save.
